children: Citi Trends Inc reported second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue growth but a swing to a loss for the period, with net sales of $211.63M, net loss of ($931K) and diluted loss per share of ($0.11) versus $190.75M, $3.82M and $0.46, respectively, in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net earnings (loss) per common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by comparable-store sales gains (12.2% YTD, 10.5% in the quarter) and net new store activity; the company operated 594 stores across 33 states.
Merchandise margin improved and shrink declined, which reduced cost-of-sales as a percentage of sales despite higher freight and elevated SG&A to support sales.
Inventory increased 7.5% to support demand, and the company invested in merchandising to align product with customer trends.
Capital spending rose to support new stores and remodels; guidance for the fiscal year capex is $35–$40M to drive growth.
